script_text: Neptune, your ruling planet, dissolved the wall you've hit since October, Pisces — this Water week starts heavy, ends electric. Monday to Wednesday, Mercury stations direct in your 9th House and sextiles Venus in your 7th House. The stalled contract or partnership talk moves Tuesday. Thursday is the turn: Mars conjunct Jupiter in your 6th House makes work impossible to ignore — a raise opens. Friday's Moon squares Saturn in your 1st House; energy drops, heart-texts wait. The Moon enters your 5th House and trines Neptune — Saturday and Sunday turn romantic, creatively profitable. Saturday is your power day because the Moon trines Neptune, your ruling planet, in your 5th House of love. Friday is your danger day because the Moon squares Saturn in your 1st House, where tiredness invites mistakes. Write deals before signing; let Saturday's trine, not Friday's fear, choose your move. Follow for daily updates.
